text: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, Air France 214. We have fire in the rear toilets, descending to flight level 40. Request an emergency landing. Position 45 miles northwest of the field, heading 150. Air France 214, Roger Mayday. Break, break, call stations. Stop transmitting Mayday. What is the current situation of the aircraft?
